intent: No platform tells an agent to wrap `auto` in GNU `timeout`, which macOS lacks.
outcome: The Shell Portability rule is byte-identical on Claude (hook-fired), Antigravity, OpenCode, and OMP; Claude fires it on a `timeout <n>` command; OpenCode lists it as an instruction; the Codex router carries the same prohibition.

assertions.needle: IMPORTANT: Do not wrap Autopus commands with GNU `timeout`
